blocks.text:
Specialist & Senior Professional Communication
เป้าหมาย: จัดทำข้อความระดับผู้บริหารที่สั้นแต่ไม่ซ่อนความเสี่ยงหรือขอบเขตอำนาจ

Use the language of specialist & senior professional communication to complete the unit's practical or interpretive task.
Identify and relay the essential information in the two readings without adding unsupported facts.
Respond to the two listening scripts with appropriate clarification and source-sensitive wording.

Reading A
A senior briefing on a fictional archive migration must support a decision without burying uncertainty in an appendix. The technical team has completed file transfer, but integrity checks cover only a sample. Describing the migration as complete collapses a delivery milestone into an assurance claim. The briefing should identify the decision requested, the evidence available, the residual uncertainty and the authority responsible for accepting it. Concision is achieved by prioritising decision-relevant distinctions, not by removing every caveat. A recommendation can be firm about the next action while remaining provisional about the system's readiness, provided the conditions for reconsideration are explicit.

Read for purpose, then locate the people, events, conditions and limits. Reconstruct the logic and rhetorical purpose of competing accounts. Test presuppositions, compression losses and shifts of agency. Preserve principled disagreement while producing a precise, audience-sensitive synthesis. Consider more than one defensible interpretation and explain why you prefer one.

Reading B
Decision note: Transfer finished. Sample integrity checks passed. Full verification outstanding. Technical lead recommends retaining the old system until verification is complete. Only the programme board can authorise retirement. No evidence in this exercise quantifies the probability of undetected errors.

Compare the two inputs: what is shared, what is additional, and what is not known? Use only details actually supplied. All characters, organisations, figures and events in these inputs are fictional classroom materials.

milestone versus assurance
หน้าที่: ไม่ให้ขั้นงานแทนการรับรอง
Model: Transfer is complete; full verification is not.
Try: change one detail while preserving the function. Check the result against the source.

until + decision condition
หน้าที่: ระบุเงื่อนไขคงระบบเดิม
Model: Retain the old system until verification is complete.
Try: change one detail while preserving the function. Check the result against the source.

only + decision owner
หน้าที่: ระบุผู้มีอำนาจ
Model: Only the programme board can authorise retirement.
Try: change one detail while preserving the function. Check the result against the source.

Thai learner guidance
ตรวจข้อสมมติที่ซ่อนอยู่ การลดทอนเมื่อย่อ การเปลี่ยนผู้รับผิดชอบและน้ำหนักถ้อยคำ ยอมรับหลายคำตีความที่มีหลักฐานโดยไม่สร้างฉันทามติเทียม

Target vocabulary in context

The technical team has completed file transfer, but integrity checks cover only a sample.

Describing the migration as complete collapses a delivery milestone into an assurance claim.

Describing the migration as complete collapses a delivery milestone into an assurance claim.

The briefing should identify the decision requested, the evidence available, the residual uncertainty and the authority responsible for accepting it.

concision — ความกระชับ
Concision is achieved by prioritising decision-relevant distinctions, not by removing every caveat.

decision-relevant — เกี่ยวข้องต่อการตัดสินใจ
Concision is achieved by prioritising decision-relevant distinctions, not by removing every caveat.

caveat — ข้อสงวน
Concision is achieved by prioritising decision-relevant distinctions, not by removing every caveat.

provisional — ชั่วคราวและพร้อมทบทวน
A recommendation can be firm about the next action while remaining provisional about the system's readiness, provided the conditions for reconsideration are explicit.

reconsideration — การพิจารณาใหม่
A recommendation can be firm about the next action while remaining provisional about the system's readiness, provided the conditions for reconsideration are explicit.

verification — การตรวจยืนยัน
Full verification outstanding.

retirement — การเลิกใช้ระบบ
Only the programme board can authorise retirement.

undetected — ที่ยังตรวจไม่พบ
No evidence in this exercise quantifies the probability of undetected errors.

rationale — เหตุผลรองรับ
Lead with the action and its rationale.

escalate — ส่งเรื่องสู่ผู้มีอำนาจ
Escalate an unresolved decision to the proper authority; do not conceal it inside a reassuring adjective.

reassuring — ทำให้วางใจ
Escalate an unresolved decision to the proper authority; do not conceal it inside a reassuring adjective.

Guided practice: cover the word bank, reconstruct five target expressions, and explain their meaning in these particular contexts. Then use two in a new example. The same word may have a different sense elsewhere.

Listening script A — authored script; recorded audio and human audio QC are pending. Reading the transcript is text-based preparation, not evidence of independent listening ability.

A: The executive wants a yes-or-no answer on retirement.
B: Then recommend no retirement yet, and state the condition that would change the recommendation.
A: Can we say the new system is unsafe?
B: We can say full verification is outstanding. Do not substitute an unsupported risk estimate.

Listening script B
Lead with the action and its rationale. Identify what has been achieved, what remains unverified and who owns the decision. If a specialist term is essential, define it once. Escalate an unresolved decision to the proper authority; do not conceal it inside a reassuring adjective.

First pass: identify purpose and main message. Second pass: note essential details and any corrections. Check against the script only after the listening attempt when approved audio becomes available. For now, practise with a teacher or partner reading the script.

Pronunciation and prosody
Use prosody strategically to manage complex interaction, signal parenthetical qualification and distinguish reported from personal stance. Judge communicative effect and intelligibility, not resemblance to an idealised native accent.

Interaction rehearsal: take both roles. Ask one clarification question, answer it using the source, and check that the other person has understood. Do not equate quietness, accent or hesitation with lack of ability.

Unit transfer task
จัดทำข้อความระดับผู้บริหารที่สั้นแต่ไม่ซ่อนความเสี่ยงหรือขอบเขตอำนาจ

Prepare a 320–420-word response and a 240–300-second spoken response using the unit inputs. Communicate fine distinctions, reconstruct dense or rhetorically complex material and mediate across purposes without erasing uncertainty or competing commitments.

Planning sequence
1. Identify audience and purpose.
2. Select source details that the audience needs.
3. Mark any uncertainty, unconfirmed arrangement or missing information.
4. Choose two language features from Lesson 2.
5. Produce the response, then check meaning before surface accuracy.

Mediation: explain the essential information to a Thai-speaking classmate who has not read the sources. Preserve dates, quantities, conditions, agency and uncertainty. Say what cannot be concluded.

Online interaction: respond to a request for clarification, then add a follow-up checking question. Acknowledge corrections and revise your message where needed.

Quick review
milestone versus assurance: Transfer is complete; full verification is not.
until + decision condition: Retain the old system until verification is complete.
only + decision owner: Only the programme board can authorise retirement.
ตรวจข้อสมมติที่ซ่อนอยู่ การลดทอนเมื่อย่อ การเปลี่ยนผู้รับผิดชอบและน้ำหนักถ้อยคำ ยอมรับหลายคำตีความที่มีหลักฐานโดยไม่สร้างฉันทามติเทียม

Self-check: Did I meet the purpose? Which source supports each factual detail? Did I make a suggestion sound confirmed? Can the other person act or understand appropriately? Which error should I revisit tomorrow?

inputs.label: Reading A
inputs.text: A senior briefing on a fictional archive migration must support a decision without burying uncertainty in an appendix. The technical team has completed file transfer, but integrity checks cover only a sample. Describing the migration as complete collapses a delivery milestone into an assurance claim. The briefing should identify the decision requested, the evidence available, the residual uncertainty and the authority responsible for accepting it. Concision is achieved by prioritising decision-relevant distinctions, not by removing every caveat. A recommendation can be firm about the next action while remaining provisional about the system's readiness, provided the conditions for reconsideration are explicit.

inputs.label: Reading B
inputs.text: Decision note: Transfer finished. Sample integrity checks passed. Full verification outstanding. Technical lead recommends retaining the old system until verification is complete. Only the programme board can authorise retirement. No evidence in this exercise quantifies the probability of undetected errors.

inputs.label: Listening script A
inputs.text:
A: The executive wants a yes-or-no answer on retirement.
B: Then recommend no retirement yet, and state the condition that would change the recommendation.
A: Can we say the new system is unsafe?
B: We can say full verification is outstanding. Do not substitute an unsupported risk estimate.

inputs.label: Listening script B
inputs.text: Lead with the action and its rationale. Identify what has been achieved, what remains unverified and who owns the decision. If a specialist term is essential, define it once. Escalate an unresolved decision to the proper authority; do not conceal it inside a reassuring adjective.

pronunciation: Use prosody strategically to manage complex interaction, signal parenthetical qualification and distinguish reported from personal stance. Judge communicative effect and intelligibility, not resemblance to an idealised native accent.

rubric.descriptors:
Target C2: Communicate fine distinctions, reconstruct dense or rhetorically complex material and mediate across purposes without erasing uncertainty or competing commitments.
4 — Fully achieves the specified purpose with precise relevant detail, coherent organisation and effective control at this target level.
3 — Achieves the main purpose; minor omissions or language lapses do not materially distort meaning.
2 — Partially achieves the purpose; important detail, organisation or language needs revision.
1 — Limited assessable evidence; major gaps or distortion impede the task.
0 — No assessable response or wholly unrelated response.
Rate each dimension separately. For mediation, invented facts, erased conditions or reversed agency prevent a high fidelity score. Do not penalise an accent or a defensible alternative phrasing. Scores describe this task only, not certified CEFR attainment.

retrieval.prompt: Without notes: recall 2 target expressions from Specialist & Senior Professional Communication; explain one source detail and use milestone versus assurance in a new example. Check meaning after attempting recall.

Without notes: recall 3 target expressions from Specialist & Senior Professional Communication; explain one source detail and use until + decision condition in a new example. Check meaning after attempting recall.

Without notes: recall 4 target expressions from Specialist & Senior Professional Communication; explain one source detail and use only + decision owner in a new example. Check meaning after attempting recall.

Without notes: recall 5 target expressions from Specialist & Senior Professional Communication; explain one source detail and use milestone versus assurance in a new example. Check meaning after attempting recall.

remediation.action: Return to Readings A/B; underline the evidence for your statement, restore any lost condition, and say explicitly what remains unknown. Retry Q-C2-11-015 and the mediation task.
Revisit the three Lesson 2 models. Identify the intended function, correct the form, and produce a new example. Retrieve the missed expression again after one day.

masteryCheck.decision: Record evidence by construct; no pass mark or CEFR certification without human standard setting.
